name: season-grain team stat excludes weeks before the player's first appearance (executed-result parity)
description: A player signed mid-season: ZGA plays 2023 REG weeks 1, 2 and 3, and the player's first gamelog row is week 3. Carry-forward is forward only, so weeks 1 and 2 carry no team -- he was on no NFL team then -- and the season cell must be week 3 alone, 60. This is the arm that separates the two live options from each other rather than from the old behaviour: summing forward-only per-week attribution gives 60, backfilling his first team to week 1 gives 150, and the year-grain majority rule also gives 150 because ZGA is his only team. The oracle is the seeded pass_yards for the weeks he was attached to ZGA, derived from the seed rather than from output.
